## About {#about}

Research Engineer in Biostatistics and Machine Learning, PhD, working at the interface of computational biostatistics and machine learning. Moroccan and French national, husband and father. I hold a PhD from Aix-Marseille University (SESSTIM laboratory) on missing data and machine learning imputation methods for survival analysis. My work focuses on building methodological tools for health data science supporting biomedical research projects. I develop open-source R packages for survival analysis, missing data, and interpretable machine learning, and contribute as a consultant and trainer in biostatistics and health data science.

## Research {#research}

- **Survival machine learning**: Individualized survival prediction | neural survival models | RMST-based summaries, and trajectory phenotyping.
- **Missing data**: Evaluation of imputation strategies
- **Interpretable ML**: Explanation workflows aligned with clinical reasoning, including SHAP-style attributions, PDP/ICE/ALE, and stability diagnostics.
- **Agentic data science**: Increasingly focused on the agentic data science paradigm — building systems where autonomous agents orchestrate analytical workflows for health research.


## Software {#software}

| Package | Purpose | Link |
|---|---|---|
| `survalis` | Interpretable survival machine learning framework | [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=survalis) |
| `survdnn` | Deep neural networks for survival analysis (R torch) | [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=survdnn) |
| `funcml` | Functional machine learning workflows | [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=funcml) |
| `unsurv` | Unsupervised clustering of individualized survival curves | [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=unsurv) |
| `tvrmst` | Time-varying RMST from survival matrices | [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=tvrmst) |
| `mcstatsim` | Monte Carlo statistical simulation (functional approach) | [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=mcstatsim) |
| `missCforest` | Ensemble conditional trees for missing data imputation | [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=missCforest) |

All packages on [CRAN](https://CRAN.R-project.org/search/?query=el+badisy) · also available via [R-universe](https://ielbadisy.r-universe.dev)
